description: This file defines a FastAPI application with an endpoint that utilizes dependency injection through a custom class 'CommonQueryParams'. It demonstrates how to handle query parameters with dependency injection and annotate them using Python's type hints and FastAPI's Depends.

classes.name: CommonQueryParams
classes.description: A class to encapsulate common query parameters including 'q', 'skip', and 'limit' for reuse across API endpoints.

methods.name: __init__(self, q: str | None = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
methods.description: Constructor for CommonQueryParams that initializes query parameters with default values.

methods.name: read_items(commons: Annotated[CommonQueryParams, Depends(CommonQueryParams)])
methods.description: An asynchronous endpoint handler that returns a filtered list of items from a fake database, utilizing dependency injection of CommonQueryParams.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, q: str | None = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100):$/
ctags.signature: (self, q: str | None = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
